text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Triple Tiara behind us, Mejiro Dober and I set our sights on the next race—the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It won't be an easy race, considering its distance and the caliber of her opponents, but it will be a great experience for her upcoming challenges.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I half expect Mejiro Dober to be nervous, but instead, she's thrilled to be entering the same race as her beloved upperclassman, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Mejiro Dober is surprised to learn she placed third in the Arima Kinen's pre-race popularity poll.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While the other Mejiro members celebrate her selection, Mejiro Dober vows to run a race worthy of a new Mejiro legacy.
